online_provider.condition_guard: complete fixed-table hash verified before arming and every row/condition fetch
online_provider.memory: selected unique D/G union plus full generator state snapshot and all named buffer snapshots; released after step; no full response target concatenation
online_provider.state_hash_cost: full generator state and buffer readback/hash once per logical step; device-local exact comparisons per fetch; Sana148M FP32 leaves need roughly595MB extra snapshot plus595MB readback/hash per step; descriptor/condition validation and all costs require runtime admission measurement
online_provider.resume: load coreG+completedstep, re-arm and deterministically regenerate selected rows; no provider RNG
online_provider.semantic_review: accepted for CPU contract prototype only; not old immutable-cache qualification
